structured_output.title: ACME E2E test infrastructure change; does not affect running cert-manager
structured_output.content: This change upgrades Pebble, a mock ACME server used only in cert-manager's E2E test suite, and updates the corresponding tests. The operator's environment is a running cert-manager deployment (Kubernetes 1.28, certificates.cert-manager.io v1 in use) with no test infrastructure. E2E test changes do not modify controller runtime behavior, APIs, or operational functionality that would affect this deployment.
